links.outcome: Change in diagnosis and treatment plan at 1 and 6 months
links.effect: Change D+TP at 6 months: MTB only 28.08%, AI only 24.3%, MTB+AI 14.73%. At 1 month: 13.12%, 8.78%, 4.86%. MTB+AI significantly lower than both. Groups were not randomized.
links.quote: The combination of the MTB with AI gives the most effective result in reducing the change in D and TP from 28.08% to 14.73% within 6 months (13.12% vs 4.86% in 1 month).

links.outcome: Diagnosis and treatment-plan changes at 1 and 6 months
links.effect: At 6 months, D + TP changes were 14.73% with MTB + AI, 24.3% with AI only, and 28.08% with MTB only; at 1 month: 4.86%, 8.78%, and 13.12%, respectively.
links.quote: The combination of the MTB with AI gives the most effective result in reducing the change in D and TP from 28.08% to 14.73% within 6 months (13.12% vs 4.86% in 1 month).

links.outcome: Clinician-rated convenience, ease of use, and willingness to continue using AI
links.effect: Positive convenience ratings increased from 54.2% to 94.1%, and ease-of-use ratings from 68.6% to 97.1%; willingness to continue AI use was 54.3% at 3 months and 64.7% at 6 months.
links.quote: However, the percentage of 54.3% and 64.7% of doctors who want to continue using AI indicates a certain conservatism, since AI is not mandatory for their clinical practice, which involves other diagnosis, complex clinical cases, etc.

links.outcome: change in diagnosis and treatment plan
links.effect: In a prospective evaluation, the combination of tumor boards with AI reduced diagnosis and treatment plan changes at 6 months to 14.73% versus 28.08% with standard care alone.
links.quote: The combination of the MTB with AI gives the most effective result in reducing the change in D and TP from 28.08% to 14.73% within 6 months.

links.outcome: change in diagnosis and treatment plan
links.effect: Evaluating clinicians with and without AI showed that the combination of human tumor boards with AI reduced subsequent plan changes to 14.73% compared to 28.08% for humans alone.
links.quote: The combination of the MTB with AI gives the most effective result in reducing the change in D and TP from 28.08% to 14.73% within 6 months.
